candidates.name: Plumefist
candidates.lore: Too heavy to fly and too proud to hide. It settles every dispute with its talons, and it looks for disputes.

candidates.name: Snapshell
candidates.lore: The tide brings it up and forgets to take it back. It holds the beach with one great claw and never learned to let go.

candidates.name: Pyrelord
candidates.lore: The mountain's first king and its only one. Every eruption since has been his voice.

candidates.name: Hollowplate
candidates.lore: The knight left long ago. The armor kept the vigil, and the fire that keeps it standing has forgotten whose it was.

candidates.name: Pebblet
candidates.lore: A pebble that pinches. The beach is full of stones, and some of them are waiting.

candidates.name: Rootfather
candidates.lore: Older than the road that was cut around it. It has forgiven the axe once, and says so, and will not do it twice.

candidates.name: Cragtroll
candidates.lore: It sleeps as a hillside and wakes as a landslide. Travellers who camp on it are the reason it wakes.

candidates.name: Marrowbolt
candidates.lore: It cannot see and does not miss. The arrows are older than the bow, and the bow is older than the wall.

candidates.name: Gravemaw
candidates.lore: It eats what the graves give up and waits for more. Its patience is only hunger, drawn out.

candidates.name: Flarewisp
candidates.lore: It burns because it is, not because it must. It follows travellers for the company and leaves them as ash.

candidates.name: Hexcrone
candidates.lore: She trades in wishes and collects in years. Every village has one story about her, and every story ends the same.

candidates.name: Scaleblade
candidates.lore: Its people ruled the marsh before the marsh drowned them. It still patrols the borders of a country that is gone.

candidates.name: Moonrend
candidates.lore: It runs the ridge under every full moon and comes back fed. The village no longer asks what it ate.

candidates.name: Stonewing
candidates.lore: It kept watch from the chapel eaves for centuries. When the last bell fell silent, it came down.

candidates.name: Stonegaze
candidates.lore: Meet its eyes and become a landmark. The roadside is lined with people who did, still pointing the way.

candidates.name: Inkling
candidates.lore: It has three hearts and holds a grudge in each. The ink is how it says goodbye.
notes: agent eyeball: the ink cloud under the body is baked into every facing and reads like a ground shadow in play — the game draws its own. Re-roll without the ink if you want it.

candidates.name: Magmatoad
candidates.lore: It basks in the lava as other toads bask on stone. Its croak carries sulphur and its bite carries fire.

candidates.name: Wrapwarden
candidates.lore: Its name was carved off the tomb, so it went looking for it. It checks every face and none of them fit.

candidates.name: Hoodfang
candidates.lore: It sways so you will watch the hood. The bite comes from where you were not watching.

candidates.name: Foxfire
candidates.lore: Three tails, three lies, and one truth it will tell you for a price you will not like.

candidates.name: Glareling
candidates.lore: It watches for something bigger. What it sees, the something bigger sees too.

candidates.name: Pebblemite
candidates.lore: It is a pebble until it isn't. Cairns are made of them, and cairns move at night.

candidates.name: Rimemite
candidates.lore: It bites once and the bite never thaws. Snow-walkers check their boots every night for good reason.

candidates.name: Broodmother
candidates.lore: Every spider in the dark is hers and every dark is a nursery. She does not hunt; she waits, and the dark brings supper.

candidates.name: Fenfather
candidates.lore: The fen itself, when the fen stands up. Villages built on it are carried off when it turns.

candidates.name: Prismfather
candidates.lore: Light goes into it and comes out wrong. Miners follow the rainbows down and are found as rainbows themselves.

candidates.name: Deepmaul
candidates.lore: It has never seen the sun and hates it on principle. Anything with a torch gets the club first.

candidates.name: Dapplekin
candidates.lore: Born where the old stag fell. The forest watches over it, and takes offence on its behalf.

candidates.name: Cinderkit
candidates.lore: A fox born in the ash beds. It is warm to the touch and will not be held.

candidates.name: Stiltwing
candidates.lore: It stands in the reeds for hours without a breath. Whatever moves beneath the water is already chosen.

candidates.name: Shellet
candidates.lore: The first of the clutch to reach the water, and the only one. It has been careful ever since.

candidates.name: Dunekit
candidates.lore: Grown cats of the dunes wear the sun as armour. This one has not yet, and hides from it in the noon shade.

candidates.name: Rimeling
candidates.lore: A splinter of the glacier that walks ahead of the cold. Where it stands, the frost arrives early.

candidates.name: Ashling
candidates.lore: Hatched in the cinder beds beneath the caldera. It will grow into a mouthful of flame; for now it only glows.

candidates.name: Deepclaw
candidates.lore: It has never seen the sun and hunts without needing to. In the deep galleries it smells a torch before the torch is lit.

candidates.name: Carrionwing
candidates.lore: It circles the road for days and lands only when it is certain. It has never once been wrong.

candidates.name: Gulo
candidates.lore: Small enough to be mistaken for prey and strong enough to drive a bear off a kill. It has done both.

candidates.name: Frostyak
candidates.lore: It crosses the high passes in weather that kills men. The herds are gone; this one still walks the route alone.

candidates.name: Warmaul
candidates.lore: It fights for whoever pays in iron and eats whoever does not. The axe has a name; it will not say it.

candidates.name: Duskplate
candidates.lore: He kept his oath after his lord broke it, and now the oath is all that is left of him.

candidates.name: Coilblade
candidates.lore: The temple in the swamp is hers and the swamp is the temple. Every stone step is guarded, and she is the steps.

candidates.name: Hornmaul
candidates.lore: The maze was built around it, not for it. It knows every turn, and it is always one turn behind you.

candidates.name: Tollkeeper
candidates.lore: The bridge is older than the town and the troll is older than the bridge. The toll has never once been coin.

candidates.name: Blackhorn
candidates.lore: The last of the wild herd, and it knows it. It charges anything that crosses the meadow, and the meadow is wide.

candidates.name: Sandsting
candidates.lore: It hides in boots and bedrolls. The sting is small; the fever it brings is not.

candidates.name: Ironhorn
candidates.lore: Siege engines were built to imitate it and none have matched it. When it charges, the wall is the softer thing.

candidates.name: Hoardmaw
candidates.lore: It has waited in the vault longer than the vault has had a door. It does not lure; it is simply there, and patient.

candidates.name: Palewick
candidates.lore: It was carried into the mine and came back alone. The light it gives leads only one way.

candidates.name: Huskling
candidates.lore: It fell from a tree nobody has found. Where it roots, the ground goes hard and the crops go quiet.

candidates.name: Grimimp
candidates.lore: The gargoyles' lesser kin, cut from the same stone. It sits in the eaves and drops on whatever passes beneath.

candidates.name: Pitjaw
candidates.lore: It digs the pit and lies beneath the floor of it. The sand slides, and whatever stood on the slope goes down to the jaws.

candidates.name: Cragram
candidates.lore: It holds the high ledge against anything that climbs. The horns have broken shields, and the mountain has never won.

candidates.name: Waystone
candidates.lore: It points the way the road went before the last Turn. Nobody has told it, and it goes on pointing.

candidates.name: Burrkin
candidates.lore: It catches on everything that passes and keeps a thread of it. None of it is worth anything and it will not put any of it down.

candidates.name: Wanderboot
candidates.lore: Somebody walked a very long way in these and does not need them now. The walking is the part that got up.

candidates.name: Woodmare
candidates.lore: Someone rode it before they were tall and remembered it long after. It rocks whether or not the ground is level.

candidates.name: Twinebale
candidates.lore: Cut, bound, and never carried in. The binding is the only thing holding its shape and it does not like being touched.

candidates.name: Grassfang
candidates.lore: It fell with the grass it was lying in. It has not noticed the difference and it bites on the same terms as before.

candidates.name: Spurcomb
candidates.lore: It ran a yard once and has not stopped running one. Everything that walks past is trespassing.

candidates.name: Skepmother
candidates.lore: The swarm remembers the keeper better than the keeper remembered the swarm. It still comes to smoke and it still stings.

candidates.name: Fingerpost
candidates.lore: Three names on it, all of them gone. It steps into the road ahead of travellers and waits to be read.

candidates.name: Briarknot
candidates.lore: The nest was left before the bramble grew around it. It keeps the eggs warm out of habit and there is nothing inside them.

candidates.name: Cartwrack
candidates.lore: It was pulled most of the way and left in sight of the fire. It is doing the last part on its own.

candidates.name: Coatheap
candidates.lore: Everything anybody left on the grass, worn at once by nothing. It stands where a fire used to be lit.

candidates.name: Deadfire
candidates.lore: A fire nobody kept long enough. What was left of it has gone looking for company.

candidates.name: Boardknight
candidates.lore: It only moves the way it is allowed to move. It always arrives from the direction nobody was watching.

candidates.name: Urchling
candidates.lore: The tide put it down and went away without it. It has been walking inland ever since, very slowly.

candidates.name: Helmcrab
candidates.lore: It chose the helmet for the fit, not the history. Something else wore it out of the sea.

candidates.name: Driftbone
candidates.lore: Everything the sea gave back, standing in the order it washed up. It does not go near the water.

candidates.name: Wrackmound
candidates.lore: A tide line that got up and kept the line with it. The crabs in it have never known anything else.

candidates.name: Whelkspire
candidates.lore: It drills the shell of anything slower than itself, which is most things. It takes a whole day and it does not hurry.

candidates.name: Netsnarl
candidates.lore: It kept fishing after the boat stopped coming. What it catches, it keeps inside itself.

candidates.name: Saltcoat
candidates.lore: It came up the beach with the wrack. It is polite, and it walks you toward the water while it talks.

candidates.name: Hullshell
candidates.lore: It was old before it fell and it has not hurried since. The beach it sleeps on was a different shape last Turn.

candidates.name: Peatling
candidates.lore: Cut out of the bank and never carried away. It puts itself back every time the water takes a piece.

candidates.name: Turfstack
candidates.lore: Stacked to dry by somebody who meant to come back for it. It has done its own drying and it is ready to be burned.

candidates.name: Mudnewt
candidates.lore: It breathes the bog through its gills and the bog has been breathing back. It is bigger every year.

candidates.name: Reedsheaf
candidates.lore: Cut for a roof that was never thatched. It stands in the shallows in the shape of the man who cut it.

candidates.name: Pitchergut
candidates.lore: It drinks whatever falls in, and it has learned what falls in most. It leans toward warmth.

candidates.name: Fengoose
candidates.lore: It owns the water it is standing in and the ground it can see. It gives one warning and the warning is loud.

candidates.name: Mirequilt
candidates.lore: The bog keeps everything and this is how it carries it. Nothing in it has finished sinking yet.

candidates.name: Ironscab
candidates.lore: The bog makes iron slowly out of water and time. Somebody used to dig this out and beat it flat.

candidates.name: Mirebell
candidates.lore: It went into the bog with the cart that was carrying it. Nobody has rung it since, and it has started ringing itself.

candidates.name: Tanhide
candidates.lore: The bog kept the outside perfectly and let the rest go. It is the oldest thing on its feet here.

candidates.name: Bogoak
candidates.lore: Five thousand years under the water made it harder than the axes that felled it. It remembers being a wood.

candidates.name: Tarseep
candidates.lore: It takes whatever lands on it and it never lets anything go. The things in its back are still in the positions they landed in.

candidates.name: Withyman
candidates.lore: Woven around nothing, on purpose, by somebody. It is the one thing here that was built rather than left.

candidates.name: Quagmaw
candidates.lore: The ground opens where it walks and closes behind it. What it takes goes down further than the bog does.

candidates.name: Millwheel
candidates.lore: It was carried here whole by somebody who hated the sight of it. It still turns, and it still has nothing to grind.

candidates.name: Fenwyrm
candidates.lore: It has been in the bog longer than the bog has been a bog. It comes up for whatever is standing on the bank.

candidates.name: Lichenhide
candidates.lore: A hundred years of lichen on something that moves. It moves that slowly.

candidates.name: Screeback
candidates.lore: The slope it came off is still missing a piece. It rebuilds itself out of whatever is underfoot.

candidates.name: Flintjaw
candidates.lore: Somebody knapped a tool out of its face a long time ago. The edges it has now, it made itself.

candidates.name: Hoodhawk
candidates.lore: Someone flew it once, and the hood is all that is left of them. It has never quite got the rest of it off.

candidates.name: Platecurl
candidates.lore: It uncoils only to move and only to eat. Stone dust is most of its diet and it has worn grooves in the road.

candidates.name: Slatespine
candidates.lore: The roof came off in a Turn and the slates stayed together. They have not found anything else to cover.

candidates.name: Quernjaw
candidates.lore: It ground for a household that is not there. It goes on turning and it is not particular about what goes in.

candidates.name: Windthorn
candidates.lore: Every rag on it was tied by somebody asking for something. It has been keeping count.

candidates.name: Wellhead
candidates.lore: The coins were put in by people who wanted something. It has been holding up its end and it is owed.

candidates.name: Boneshale
candidates.lore: It was a shape before this was stone. The stone is the only part of it that is still here.

candidates.name: Rockface
candidates.lore: Somebody cut a face into it to be looked at by. Only the face moves, the rest is still a rock.

candidates.name: Packhusk
candidates.lore: It keeps to the road and it keeps a good pace. It has been going up for a long time.

candidates.name: Stonemoot
candidates.lore: It was stood up by people who are not remembered, for a reason that is not either. Things were left in the hollow and things were taken out.

candidates.name: Greywyrm
candidates.lore: It has been part of the mountain road shape for as long as the road has had one. Carts used to be routed around it.

candidates.name: Rollmoss
candidates.lore: It rolls a little each day and the moss grows even because of it. Nothing is inside but the stone it started on.

candidates.name: Snowgrouse
candidates.lore: It is white all winter and it does not know when winter ends here. It breaks cover at the last possible moment.

candidates.name: Snowlip
candidates.lore: It is the piece of the ridge that was about to fall. It has been about to fall for a long time now.

candidates.name: Rimebeard
candidates.lore: It grew out of one night of cold on something that was already dead. Warm breath takes pieces off it.

candidates.name: Sledgeback
candidates.lore: It was hauled up and left when the hauling stopped. The load has not been looked at since.

candidates.name: Pressridge
candidates.lore: Two sheets of ice pushed until one had to go up. The grinding noise it makes is the same noise it made before it stood.

candidates.name: Icecore
candidates.lore: Everything inside it fell in a very long time ago. It is thawing from the middle out.

candidates.name: Windpine
candidates.lore: It grew for two hundred years into the same wind. It leans the same way even indoors.

candidates.name: Icemask
candidates.lore: It breathes and there is nothing in it to breathe. It stands where the path is easiest and waits to be followed.

candidates.name: Slabfall
candidates.lore: It came off the face in nine seconds and it has not settled since. It is quiet until it is not.

candidates.name: Thawborn
candidates.lore: The thaw gives back what the snow was keeping, in one piece, walking. It comes down the mountain every year.

candidates.name: Moraine
candidates.lore: The ice pushed it ahead of itself for a thousand years and then let go. It is still going in the same direction.

candidates.name: Icefall
candidates.lore: The water inside it never stopped. It is the loudest thing on the mountain and it only speaks in thaw.

candidates.name: Pumicekin
candidates.lore: It came out of the mountain in the air, not the ground. It weighs almost nothing and it is nearly impossible to catch.

candidates.name: Basaltkin
candidates.lore: It cooled into these shapes on its own, in straight lines, without being cut. The mountain does this and nobody knows why it is neat.

candidates.name: Ashfall
candidates.lore: It settled over everything that was there in one afternoon. The prints in it are not of anything that is still here.

candidates.name: Ventworm
candidates.lore: It lives off the heat itself and has never needed light. Where it is, the rock is too hot to stand on.

candidates.name: Glasscut
candidates.lore: Every part of it is an edge. It has never had to learn to swing anything.

candidates.name: Brimstone
candidates.lore: The smell reaches further than it does. Things that live near it stopped smelling anything years ago.

candidates.name: Cindermask
candidates.lore: It burned and kept the shape it burned in. Pieces come off it and it does not notice.

candidates.name: Riftmaw
candidates.lore: The mountain opened here and the opening walked away. The crack in it has never closed and never widened.

candidates.name: Cavepearl
candidates.lore: It was turned smooth by dripping water over a thousand years and it is still turning. The others in the pool are its earlier attempts.

candidates.name: Dripstone
candidates.lore: It grew one drop at a time and it has not changed the habit. Everything it does takes the same amount of patience.

candidates.name: Whitegill
candidates.lore: It has never needed eyes and it does not have them. It knows the shape of the water it is in perfectly.

candidates.name: Gypsumkin
candidates.lore: It grew out of the wall where no water ever ran. Touching it takes a piece off and the piece does not grow back.

candidates.name: Flowstone
candidates.lore: It is the shape of water that ran down the same rock for ten thousand years. Now it walks and the water still runs down it.

candidates.name: Foldwing
candidates.lore: It keeps everything inside the wings until it does not. The ears are working the whole time.

candidates.name: Moonmilk
candidates.lore: It takes a print from anything that touches it and keeps it. Some of the prints on it are very small.

candidates.name: Firstmask
candidates.lore: The simplest thing the cave makes. It is always facing you and it has never once hurried.

candidates.name: Sinterstep
candidates.lore: Warm water built it a step at a time on its way down. The pools on it are still the right temperature.

candidates.name: Sumpcrawl
candidates.lore: The sump gave up its shape but not its contents. It has been carrying that lamp for a long time.

candidates.name: Goodguest
candidates.lore: It steps aside to let you go first, every time. Hearn said it asked politely, and he is the only one who came back up.

candidates.name: Maskbearer
candidates.lore: It has one already. The one it is holding is the right size for you.

candidates.name: Facewall
candidates.lore: The faces come further out the longer you look at it. None of them are finished and all of them are the same one.

candidates.name: Thinning
candidates.lore: It is most of the way to the Quiet and it has stopped going. Standing near it is cold in a way that is not temperature.

candidates.name: Masktable
candidates.lore: Eleven masks, one face, laid out for people who are not here yet. It sets them out again if they are moved.

candidates.name: Listener
candidates.lore: It has no face because it is not for being looked at. It leans in when you speak and it does not miss anything.

candidates.name: Maskfather
candidates.lore: It is the one that sets the table. The blank ones under its arm have not been assigned yet.

candidates.name: Holemaw
candidates.lore: The hole under the mountain, standing up. It is new, and the oldest here say the worst part is who it has to be.

candidates.name: Deadletter
candidates.lore: Everything posted in it is still in it. The names on the letters are of people who are here.

candidates.name: Ironstove
candidates.lore: It went out when the house emptied and it has not been lit since. The kettle on it has never been taken off.

candidates.name: Anvilhorn
candidates.lore: It took every blow in the settlement for years. It has started returning them.

candidates.name: Plinthstep
candidates.lore: It was put up for somebody. Nobody left can read the base and nobody left knows who.

candidates.name: Emptychair
candidates.lore: One chair from a long table, still set for somebody. It follows the person who sat in it.

candidates.name: Mirrorface
candidates.lore: It shows a face and it is not the face of whoever is in front of it. It does not move when you do.

candidates.name: Doorward
candidates.lore: The house went in a Turn and the door stayed. There is knocking on the other side of it.

candidates.name: Stoppedclock
candidates.lore: It stopped at a time nobody can place and it is still swinging. In here that is not a contradiction.

candidates.name: Canvashusk
candidates.lore: It was pitched in a bad place by somebody who knew better. The shape it holds is not a shape anybody is still in.
